company.name: MejorCDT
company.shortDescription: MejorCDT is an investment platform for Latin America that aims to make investing safe and simple.
company.description: MejorCDT Investment Platform for Fixed-Term Products. They offer high-yield savings accounts as their initial product, allowing users to compare and invest in accounts without visiting a physical bank. Additionally, they plan to expand their offerings to include corporate bonds, stocks, and cryptocurrencies.

productsAndServices.description: An online tool that allows users to simulate and compare CDT interest rates from multiple banks in real time to select the best investment option.
productsAndServices.name: Simulador de CDT (CDT Simulator)

productsAndServices.description: A service that facilitates opening Certificates of Deposit (CDTs) with partner banks remotely, without requiring users to visit bank branches.
productsAndServices.name: CDT Opening Service

productsAndServices.description: A product that allows investors to withdraw up to 10 million COP from their CDT before maturity without penalties, subject to certain conditions.
productsAndServices.name: CDT Flexible (Flexible CDT)

productsAndServices.description: A CDT product that allows investors to add funds to their existing CDT investment at any time, increasing their investment without opening a new CDT.
productsAndServices.name: CDT Recargable (Reloadable CDT)
